metadata.title: 360 Hipódromo Living – Urban Condos for Sale in Zona Hipódromo, Tijuana
metadata.description: 360 Hipódromo Living is a vertical urban development by UNOBRA in Zona Hipódromo, Tijuana, steps from Zona Río's restaurants, offices, and nightlife. Modern design and high rental demand in the heart of the city.

hero.heroImageAlt: 360 Hipódromo Living residences, Zona Hipódromo, Tijuana
hero.headline: Urban living at the center of it all
hero.description: 360 Hipódromo Living puts you steps from Zona Río's restaurants, offices, and nightlife, in one of Tijuana's most walkable and in-demand neighborhoods — designed for city life and high rental returns.

location.description: Walking distance to Zona Río's offices, restaurants, and nightlife, next to Agua Caliente and minutes from the Otay border crossing — one of Tijuana's most connected addresses.

developer.heading: About the developer
developer.description: UNOBRA is a real estate developer with more than three decades of experience, recognized for creating communities that combine design, innovation, and high construction quality. Its track record, backed by thousands of homes delivered and a strong presence across northern Mexico, positions it as a company committed to developing projects that generate appreciation, well-being, and long-term property value. In Baja California, developments such as 360 Hipódromo and Costa Coronado reflect its vision of offering modern, functional spaces designed for the growth of cities and of those who invest in them.
